answer: In a lagoon monitoring market, each agent must lock a fixed bond for 30 days before accepting a contract to deliver sensor data by dawn. A smart contract slashes the bond if no signed report arrives by the deadline. Creating identities is cheap, but activating each one requires fresh collateral: a swarm of 1,000 agents ties up 1,000 bonds, and missed deliveries turn that capital lockup into a spiral of losses.
